jobs.subject: Domed limestone library with copper verdigris dome, slate wings, ornate fine stonework and climbing ivy.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production isometric pixel-art city sprite, a single original domed library. Reference image already inspected: tiny.london preview by Boris Starkov, used only for painterly architectural pixel detail, realistic proportions, lush muted colours; create original architecture, no copying map or text. An elegant warm limestone civic library, copper verdigris dome, slate wings, fine tall windows, recessed entrance with books visible, small climbing ivy. Strict orthographic 2:1 isometric: ground axes slope exactly +1/2 and -1/2, verticals vertical. Daylight from upper left, softly shadowed right facades. Muted palette warm stone #c9bd98, roof #58666b, copper #6e9485, leaves #597949, shadow #3d5149. No outlines, no cartoon exaggeration, no perspective vanishing point. A full isolated building with no ground plinth, no lawn tile, no text, no frame; actual transparent background including negative spaces, soft minimal contact shadow only. Canvas 1024x1024, centred with ample clear margin. Footprint 3x3 tiles, one tile 128x64 in final use; building intended to occupy 384px width, doors 42px high, library total height about 320px at final scale. Crisp painterly pixel clusters and small architectural details, not smooth 3D rendering. One sprite only. Produce PNG with real alpha.
